Playbook

# Design system playbook

A scheduling product built around a calendar of events. The UI centers on a monthly calendar (@app/page::Calendar) with a legend of event categories (@app/page::Legend), a list of upcoming events (@app/upcoming/page::Upcoming), per-event detail pages (@app/events/[id]/page::EventDetail), a gear section that tracks equipment needs (@app/gear/page::Needs), and a stand-ins page (@app/standins/page::StandinsPage). Navigation is provided by a shared shell (@lib/AppShell::AppShell) with icon links, access is gated by a login page (@app/login/page::LoginPage) and an auth provider (@lib/auth::AuthProvider), and events carry collaborative notes (@lib/SharedNotes::SharedNotes) edited in rich text and rendered as Markdown. The token set in app/globals.css defines a base palette (t0, t1, t2, t10, t14, t15), a primary ramp (t3, t4, t5, t6, t7), status colors for confirmed and pending states (t9, t17), and named category colors (t12, t13, t16), alongside foreground/background tokens (t8, t11).
